fields.Name: IT08 - Aggregates Through The Cache
fields.Description: Proves the cache invariants for RunView aggregates. AGG1: the Aggregates[] array participates in the cache fingerprint (the aggHash) — adding aggregates, and changing them, changes the fingerprint, so two views identical except for their aggregates never collide on a slot. AGG2: aggregate results round-trip through the cache — a cold aggregate RunView writes a slot AND returns AggregateResults; the warm hit is served (zero writes) and STILL returns AggregateResults. AGG3: AggregateResults are returned in the caller's requested order, including when a semantically-equivalent view with a different Aggregates[] order was cached first. Aggregates over 'MJ: User Settings'; no mutation.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Aggregates[] participates in the fingerprint (aggHash); AggregateResults round-trips through a warm cache hit and preserves the caller's requested order.
